sloka: अहो धिङ्मानुषं लोकं नास्ति खल्वधमः परः ।यद्दुर्बला बलवता भर्तारो रावणेन नः ।। ७.२४.१७ ॥
transliteration: aho dhiṅmānuṣaṁ lokaṁ nāsti khalvadhamaḥ paraḥ ।yaddurbalā balavatā bhartāro rāvaṇena naḥ ।। 7.24.17 ॥

translations.english: Alas, shame upon the human race, for there is indeed nothing lower than this, that our husbands are weak before the mighty Ravana.
